subject: [RFC PATCH 3/4] memcg_ext: allow BPF to defer memory.high enforcement

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch allows BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) programs to defer memory.high enforcement, which prevents tasks holding kernel locks from being stuck in the charge path. It introduces high_policy ops that provide a read-only snapshot of the charge and allow programs to return a request. This approach enables more efficient handling of memory allocation and deallocation by allowing BPF programs to manage memory usage without blocking other tasks.
